name: Philips 65OLED706/12 (TP Vision, PH1M_EA_9970A, MediaTek MT5895), France; 55OLED706/12, Poland
warnings: Read the 50PUS8517 quirks and its DO NOT DISABLE block first: they apply here as written, and nothing in that block is disabled below (xtv, eum, aurora, playtv, nettvbrowser, browser engine, Ambilight, remote, firmware update...).
Injected keys over adb do not dismiss the logo, and the shell cannot write to the remote's input device on this firmware (sendevent: Permission denied), so test it with the real remote. 5.

Chromecast (mediashell) re-enables itself, as on the 50PUS8517: left out. 7. show_stats and the CPU figure: apps cannot read the CPU load here. /proc/stat and /proc/loadavg are denied to apps on this Android 11 build, and the kernel has no cpuidle (no /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpuidle).
The load average read over adb sits around 36 on 4 cores at idle, so it would not be a usable stand-in anyway.
Memory and storage read fine; the CPU part is left out.
